info.title: SUtech Transport API
info.description: Generated from the front end's endpoint definitions. Times are ISO 8601 with the Africa/Cairo offset; money is whole EGP.

post.summary: Send a one-time code to the phone registered for a student ID, staff ID or parent phone.
post.description: Public: no token needed.

post.summary: Exchange the identifier and the one-time code for a bearer token that carries the role.
post.description: Public: no token needed.

get.summary: The signed-in account and its role.
get.description: Allowed roles: super_admin, transport_admin, finance, clinic, student_affairs, secretary_general, bus_company, driver, supervisor, student, parent. Every other role gets 403.

post.summary: Revoke the current token.
post.description: Allowed roles: super_admin, transport_admin, finance, clinic, student_affairs, secretary_general, bus_company, driver, supervisor, student, parent. Every other role gets 403.

get.summary: All lines with stops, times, price and free seats.
get.description: Allowed roles: super_admin, transport_admin, finance, clinic, student_affairs, secretary_general, bus_company, driver, supervisor, student, parent. Every other role gets 403.

get.summary: One line.
get.description: Allowed roles: super_admin, transport_admin, finance, clinic, student_affairs, secretary_general, bus_company, driver, supervisor, student, parent. Every other role gets 403.

get.summary: Current term, booking window, next term dates and the refund policy.
get.description: Allowed roles: super_admin, transport_admin, finance, clinic, student_affairs, secretary_general, bus_company, driver, supervisor, student, parent. Every other role gets 403.

patch.summary: Open or close booking for the current term.
patch.description: Allowed roles: super_admin, transport_admin. Every other role gets 403.

put.summary: Set the next term's booking window; optionally schedule the booking-opened announcement.
put.description: Allowed roles: super_admin, transport_admin. Every other role gets 403.

get.summary: The student's subscription for the current term (status none when there is none).
get.description: Allowed roles: student. Every other role gets 403.

post.summary: Reserve a seat on a line at a stop. Holds the seat 24 hours and fixes the price.
post.description: Allowed roles: student. Every other role gets 403.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Repeat calls with the same key must run once.

post.summary: Cancel an unpaid reservation and release the seat.
post.description: Allowed roles: student. Every other role gets 403.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Repeat calls with the same key must run once.

post.summary: Create (or return the existing) Fawry reference for the reserved seat. Fawry confirms by callback.
post.description: Allowed roles: student. Every other role gets 403.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Repeat calls with the same key must run once.

post.summary: Upload an InstaPay or bank transfer receipt for finance to review.
post.description: Allowed roles: student. Every other role gets 403.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Repeat calls with the same key must run once.

get.summary: Payments, pending receipts first.
get.description: Allowed roles: super_admin, finance. Every other role gets 403.

patch.summary: Approve a receipt (activates the subscription) or reject it with a reason.
patch.description: Allowed roles: super_admin, finance. Every other role gets 403.

get.summary: Digital card with a signed QR that expires after 30 seconds. Active subscribers only.
get.description: Allowed roles: student. Every other role gets 403.

get.summary: The student's day: not-going report, boarding, arrival, check-out or absence.
get.description: Allowed roles: student. Every other role gets 403.

post.summary: "Not going today": tells the driver, the transport office and the parent. No absence is recorded.
post.description: Allowed roles: student. Every other role gets 403.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Repeat calls with the same key must run once.

delete.summary: Take back a not-going report (before the student boards).
delete.description: Allowed roles: student. Every other role gets 403.

get.summary: Attendance for a date, optionally one line (query: date, line).
get.description: Allowed roles: super_admin, transport_admin. Every other role gets 403.

get.summary: The student's bus: position from the bus GPS unit, ETA to their stop, delay. Active subscribers only.
get.description: Allowed roles: student. Every other role gets 403.

get.summary: The child's bus, for the parent.
get.description: Allowed roles: parent. Every other role gets 403.

get.summary: Every line's bus right now, with boarded / expected riders.
get.description: Allowed roles: super_admin, transport_admin. Every other role gets 403.

get.summary: Today's extra return trips.
get.description: Allowed roles: student, super_admin, transport_admin. Every other role gets 403.

post.summary: Book a seat on an extra trip (active subscribers).
post.description: Allowed roles: student. Every other role gets 403.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Repeat calls with the same key must run once.

post.summary: Give the seat back.
post.description: Allowed roles: student. Every other role gets 403.

post.summary: Announce an extra return trip; the line's students are notified.
post.description: Allowed roles: super_admin, transport_admin. Every other role gets 403.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Repeat calls with the same key must run once.

post.summary: Cancel an extra trip; booked students are notified.
post.description: Allowed roles: super_admin, transport_admin. Every other role gets 403.

get.summary: When each group's last lecture ends today, to suggest return trips.
get.description: Allowed roles: super_admin, transport_admin. Every other role gets 403.

get.summary: Announcements for the caller: official ones for everyone, line alerts for the student's line (or a parent's children's lines).
get.description: Allowed roles: super_admin, transport_admin, finance, clinic, student_affairs, secretary_general, bus_company, driver, supervisor, student, parent. Every other role gets 403.

get.summary: Published and scheduled announcements.
get.description: Allowed roles: super_admin, transport_admin. Every other role gets 403.

post.summary: Publish now or schedule an announcement. A delay also sets the line's ETA offset.
post.description: Allowed roles: super_admin, transport_admin. Every other role gets 403.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Repeat calls with the same key must run once.

patch.summary: Pin or unpin an official announcement on the students' home screen.
patch.description: Allowed roles: super_admin, transport_admin. Every other role gets 403.

delete.summary: Delete an announcement for everyone: it disappears from students and parents together with the notifications it sent, and any delay it set is cleared.
delete.description: Allowed roles: super_admin, transport_admin. Every other role gets 403.

post.summary: Publish a scheduled announcement now.
post.description: Allowed roles: super_admin, transport_admin. Every other role gets 403.

delete.summary: Cancel a scheduled announcement before it goes out.
delete.description: Allowed roles: super_admin, transport_admin. Every other role gets 403.

get.summary: Lines running late right now.
get.description: Allowed roles: super_admin, transport_admin. Every other role gets 403.

post.summary: Back on schedule: ends the delay and tells the line's students.
post.description: Allowed roles: super_admin, transport_admin, driver. Every other role gets 403.

get.summary: The caller's notifications, newest first, with the unread count.
get.description: Allowed roles: super_admin, transport_admin, finance, clinic, student_affairs, secretary_general, bus_company, driver, supervisor, student, parent. Every other role gets 403.

post.summary: Mark every notification read.
post.description: Allowed roles: super_admin, transport_admin, finance, clinic, student_affairs, secretary_general, bus_company, driver, supervisor, student, parent. Every other role gets 403.

get.summary: Which optional alerts the student receives.
get.description: Allowed roles: student. Every other role gets 403.

put.description: Allowed roles: student. Every other role gets 403.

get.summary: The student's requests and where each one is.
get.description: Allowed roles: student. Every other role gets 403.

post.summary: Open a request. One open request at a time; active subscribers only.
post.description: Allowed roles: student. Every other role gets 403.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Repeat calls with the same key must run once.

post.summary: The parent approves or rejects (first step of refunds and line changes).
post.description: Allowed roles: parent. Every other role gets 403.

get.summary: Requests waiting on the caller's office, plus the history.
get.description: Allowed roles: super_admin, transport_admin, finance. Every other role gets 403.

patch.summary: Approve or reject the current step. The last approval carries the request out.
patch.description: Allowed roles: super_admin, transport_admin, finance. Every other role gets 403.

get.summary: The student's complaints and replies.
get.description: Allowed roles: student. Every other role gets 403.

post.summary: File a complaint. Payment complaints are allowed after booking, the rest after activation.
post.description: Allowed roles: student. Every other role gets 403.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Repeat calls with the same key must run once.

get.summary: All complaints, newest first.
get.description: Allowed roles: super_admin, transport_admin, secretary_general. Every other role gets 403.

post.summary: Reply once; the student is notified.
post.description: Allowed roles: super_admin, transport_admin. Every other role gets 403.

post.summary: Ask the transport assistant (built by the AI team).
post.description: Allowed roles: student. Every other role gets 403.

get.summary: The children linked to this parent.
get.description: Allowed roles: parent. Every other role gets 403.

get.summary: The child's day (query: date). Only children linked to the parent.
get.description: Allowed roles: parent. Every other role gets 403.

get.summary: The children's requests, including those waiting for the parent's decision.
get.description: Allowed roles: parent. Every other role gets 403.

get.summary: The crew member's trip today with the rider list.
get.description: Allowed roles: driver, supervisor. Every other role gets 403.

post.summary: Start the outbound or return trip (driver only).
post.description: Allowed roles: driver. Every other role gets 403.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Repeat calls with the same key must run once.

post.summary: End the trip. Ending the outbound trip marks every subscriber who wasn't scanned and didn't report not going as absent, and notifies their parents.
post.description: Allowed roles: driver. Every other role gets 403.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Repeat calls with the same key must run once.

post.summary: Scan a card to board, or to check out mid-trip with a reason (the parent is notified at once). Rejects cancelled cards and other lines.
post.description: Allowed roles: driver, supervisor. Every other role gets 403.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Repeat calls with the same key must run once.

post.summary: Report a delay; the line's students and the transport office are told.
post.description: Allowed roles: driver, supervisor. Every other role gets 403.

post.summary: Raise an SOS. Reaches the transport office at once; medical cases also reach the clinic.
post.description: Allowed roles: driver, supervisor. Every other role gets 403.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Repeat calls with the same key must run once.

get.summary: One SOS, for the crew that raised it.
get.description: Allowed roles: driver, supervisor. Every other role gets 403.

get.summary: SOS cases, open first. The clinic sees medical cases only.
get.description: Allowed roles: super_admin, transport_admin, clinic. Every other role gets 403.

patch.summary: Acknowledge, request an ambulance, add a note, or close with what was done.
patch.description: Allowed roles: super_admin, transport_admin, clinic. Every other role gets 403.

post.summary: Swap the bus (and its driver) on a running trip. Riders and attendance move to the new bus; the line's students are told.
post.description: Allowed roles: super_admin, transport_admin. Every other role gets 403.

post.summary: Report a violation with an optional photo.
post.description: Allowed roles: driver, supervisor. Every other role gets 403.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Repeat calls with the same key must run once.

get.summary: All violations.
get.description: Allowed roles: super_admin, transport_admin, student_affairs. Every other role gets 403.

patch.summary: Refer to security and student affairs, or file without action.
patch.description: Allowed roles: super_admin, transport_admin, student_affairs. Every other role gets 403.

get.summary: All buses, their driver, line and status.
get.description: Allowed roles: super_admin, transport_admin. Every other role gets 403.

post.summary: Add a bus.
post.description: Allowed roles: super_admin, transport_admin. Every other role gets 403.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Repeat calls with the same key must run once.

put.summary: Edit a bus. If it serves a line, the line's students are told about a plate or driver change.
put.description: Allowed roles: super_admin, transport_admin. Every other role gets 403.

post.summary: Create a line on a free bus. The university gate is added as the last stop.
post.description: Allowed roles: super_admin, transport_admin. Every other role gets 403.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Repeat calls with the same key must run once.

patch.summary: Change the term price for new bookings (existing bookings keep their price).
patch.description: Allowed roles: super_admin, transport_admin. Every other role gets 403.

post.summary: Add a stop before the university gate.
post.description: Allowed roles: super_admin, transport_admin. Every other role gets 403.

patch.summary: Turn a stop on or off. A stop with booked students can't be turned off.
patch.description: Allowed roles: super_admin, transport_admin. Every other role gets 403.

get.summary: Students with their subscription (query: line, q).
get.description: Allowed roles: super_admin, transport_admin. Every other role gets 403.

post.summary: Move a student to another line for today, until a date, or permanently. Student and parent are notified.
post.description: Allowed roles: super_admin, transport_admin. Every other role gets 403.

post.summary: Cancel a subscription for a violation (clause 10). The card stops working at once.
post.description: Allowed roles: super_admin, transport_admin. Every other role gets 403.

get.summary: Dashboard numbers, line occupancy and the activity feed.
get.description: Allowed roles: super_admin, transport_admin, secretary_general. Every other role gets 403.

get.summary: Audit log: who did what and when (query: page, page_size).
get.description: Allowed roles: super_admin. Every other role gets 403.

get.summary: Staff accounts and their roles.
get.description: Allowed roles: super_admin. Every other role gets 403.

post.summary: Create a staff account with one role.
post.description: Allowed roles: super_admin. Every other role gets 403.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Repeat calls with the same key must run once.

patch.summary: Change a role or turn an account off. The last active super admin can't be turned off.
patch.description: Allowed roles: super_admin. Every other role gets 403.

get.summary: Export a report (query: line, date, format=xlsx|pdf|csv).
get.description: Allowed roles: super_admin, transport_admin, finance, secretary_general. Every other role gets 403.

get.summary: Clinic permits (priority seat, medical leave, escort).
get.description: Allowed roles: super_admin, clinic. Every other role gets 403.

post.summary: Issue a permit; the transport office and the driver see it, the student is notified.
post.description: Allowed roles: super_admin, clinic. Every other role gets 403.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Repeat calls with the same key must run once.

post.summary: Revoke a permit.
post.description: Allowed roles: super_admin, clinic. Every other role gets 403.

get.summary: Bus bookings for university events.
get.description: Allowed roles: super_admin, transport_admin. Every other role gets 403.

post.summary: Book buses for an event: spare university buses first, the rest requested from the bus company.
post.description: Allowed roles: super_admin, transport_admin. Every other role gets 403.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Repeat calls with the same key must run once.

post.summary: Cancel an event booking; the buses become spare again.
post.description: Allowed roles: super_admin, transport_admin. Every other role gets 403.

get.summary: Bus requests sent to the bus company.
get.description: Allowed roles: super_admin, bus_company. Every other role gets 403.

post.summary: The bus company confirms or declines.
post.description: Allowed roles: super_admin, bus_company. Every other role gets 403.

code.description: Stable machine code the UI translates, e.g. OTP_INVALID, FORBIDDEN.

message.description: Developer message; never shown to users as is.
